changes.reason: Preserve 不因此: external provenance is insufficient evidence, not a blanket exclusion.

changes.before: This is where occupation and locking do their real work. They do not make the state worse. They close the gap between signature and state. For the bearer's own law to have independently made this constituting, he must have had candidates available out of his own sources, and must have kept revision. If the candidate field is filled by a single grammar and the revisable place is voided in advance, the echo reading has no room left. Three signatures complete: the reading is determinate.

changes.before: Partial combinations get no names of their own. Occupation and locking both present with no attribution is naked coercion, which does not even enter the genus. The other two combinations each contain an attribution, so both stop at cannot-determine; two signatures being present does not buy a determinate reading. Coining names for these would only dilute the criterion: they either already have a place under locking, or they have no reading yet to name. This applies to partial combinations only. Complete forms are typed by the character of the content-domain, and are not covered by it: a domain whose first-person place has not yet come to run of itself gives pre-occupation; the domain of the bearer's own value-standing gives self-colonization. Each has its name and its own way of being judged.

changes.before: Occupation is the candidate field arranged from outside to this degree: in some content-domain, the bearer can no longer get a candidate out of any row of his own sources. There are two ways to reach the threshold. The endogenous road is pressed shut, so that nothing in this domain surfaces out of his own working. Or the outside road is filled by a single effective grammar of appraisal, so that candidates not issuing from that grammar cannot enter. Both point at one thing: in this domain, every available candidate comes from one place, and that place is not the bearer.

Or the outside road is filled by a single effective grammar of appraisal, so that candidates not issuing from that grammar cannot enter. Both point at one thing: in this domain, every available candidate comes from one place, and that place is not the bearer.
changes.reason: Preserve the source-row formulation without broadening it explicitly to every row.

changes.before: The threshold clause is part of the criterion. Arranging what someone sees first is neither remarkable nor harmful in itself. A good demonstration arranges what you see first too: a skilled hand sets a craft in front of you, a work brings a way of living within reach — and these fall in the direction opposite to occupation. The line is not whether there was arranging, but whether the space is larger or smaller afterwards. Appearance, reachability, expression, revision and bridging maintained or enlarged: releasing shaping. Pressed down out of reach: occupation. Showing you many things is not occupation; making you unable to see anything else is.
changes.after: The threshold clause is part of the criterion. Arranging what someone sees first is neither remarkable nor harmful in itself. A good demonstration arranges what you see first too: a skilled hand sets a craft in front of you, a work brings a way of living within reach — all of these arrange the order of appearance, and they fall in the direction opposite to occupation. The line is not whether there was arranging, but whether the space is larger or smaller afterwards. Appearance, reachability, expression, revision and bridging maintained or enlarged: releasing shaping. Pressed down out of reach: occupation. Showing you many things is not occupation; making you unable to see anything else is.
changes.reason: Restore the explicit common feature shared by demonstration, work and arranging.

There is another question you can ask: in this structure, on what does this content count as the bearer's?

changes.before: That last form needs a line drawn around it. What falls under this judgment is not the assessment itself. A diagnosis, an evaluation, an outside description — so long as it leaves the bearer's places of refusal, review, second opinion and self-restatement standing, those places are open, however unwelcome or humiliating the assessment. What falls under this judgment is the step of pre-coding denial as symptom, because that is exactly what abolishes those places. It is the same shape as the previous essay's rule about locking: an offensive action is not a closing action; what is judged is whether the places are open, not how it felt.

changes.before: Locking needs no actor. Even where no one reached in and touched a man's revisable place, that place can already have failed; an appraisal no one enforces, an atmosphere no one is answerable for, falls on the locking side.
changes.after: Locking needs no actor. Even where no one reached in and touched a man's revisable place, that place can already have failed; a system of appraisal no one intentionally promotes, an atmosphere no one is answerable for, falls on the locking side.
changes.reason: Restore 无人有意推行 rather than denying enforcement altogether.

changes.before: Here is a general rule that blocks more misuse than the criterion itself. Revision and change are never evidence of colonization. They are evidence that the place is open.
changes.after: Here is a general rule that blocks more misuse than the criterion itself. Revision and change in themselves are never evidence of colonization. They are evidence that the place is open.
changes.reason: Restore 本身, the qualification on what change alone establishes.

changes.before: Two things are visible on this branch at once. Discovery has not held: the content never took a position under any row of his own. And something else stands in its place: an external warrant — something from outside his own sources holding up the standing of it counts. The warrant may be a reading issued by another's circuit of ends, an institutional arrangement, an authoritative pronouncement. The warrant is partly observable; whether discovery held is not.
changes.after: Two things can be distinguished on this branch at once. Discovery has not held: the content never took a position under any row of his own. changes.reason: 辨出 does not assert external visibility; discovery is expressly not externally observable.

changes.before: What is built between warrant and source has no fixed form. It can be inferential: since this value holds, I ought to have it too. It can be credential: another, or a third party, told me this, and I respond accordingly. It can be receiving an assigned place: they need me for this, so this is where my use lies. Form does not enter the judgment; the criterion asks only where the standing stops. Credence especially needs holding down: taking something on credit while the content also takes a position under one of your own rows is the ordinary way value occurs. Taking it on credit with the standing resting only on that pronouncement is what falls here. And ought to is this step's own tone of voice: whether there is a position under a row of source is not a matter of ought.
changes.after: What is built between warrant and source has no fixed form. It can be inferential: since this value holds, I ought to have it too. It can take the form of accepting testimony: another, or a third party, told me this, and I respond accordingly. Credence especially needs holding down: taking something on credit while the content also takes a position under one of your own rows is the ordinary way value occurs. Taking it on credit with the standing resting only on that pronouncement is what falls here. And ought to is this step's own tone of voice: whether there is a position under a row of source is not a matter of ought.
changes.reason: 采信 is taking something on another’s word, not a credential.

changes.before: The 15DD row is structurally unlike the first three. Its content is the other to begin with, so the borrowing that goes wrong on the first three does not go wrong here on contact; it is the row least prone to error. What this row anchors is not the other's content of ends, but the other's standing as an end, and the fact that the first-person source of its value cannot be given, written or replaced by me.

changes.before: The first separates it from 15DD's other-directed content. Cherishing someone's peace, cherishing a shared undertaking, cherishing care — these contents are full of the other, and really do require looking toward the other repeatedly, because the other is their object. The line is direction on the source-figure: on the 15DD row the bearer is the end that issues ends, and takes the other as an end; in the reading of uses the bearer is the end that gets used, and the other takes him as a means. Same matter, opposite directions, different cells. Read the direction; there is no need to imagine what would happen if the other were removed.

changes.before: So the only usable tense is retrospect. Afterwards, at a distance, the bearer asks again on what this content is his, and follows the account backwards: does the chain of standing finally stop at one of his own rows of source, or at an external warrant. This is not present-moment introspection. It is confronting yourself across time.

changes.before: What is read is the landing point at that moment, not what came afterwards. The distinction matters, because results prove nothing here. A content later coming back from one of his own rows proves that by then it had taken a position — another event happened — and does not prove it was there originally. Conversely, its not coming back does not prove it never had a position: presence of a source and reachability of a source are two things, and not coming back may only mean reachability is still sealed. So whether recurrence happens is a thread, not a necessary and sufficient condition.
changes.after: What is read is the landing point at that moment, not what came afterwards. The distinction matters, because subsequent results cannot establish that earlier landing point. A content later coming back from one of his own rows proves that by then it had taken a position — another event happened — and does not prove it was there originally. Conversely, its not coming back does not prove it never had a position: presence of a source and reachability of a source are two things, and not coming back may only mean reachability is still sealed. So whether recurrence happens is a thread, not a necessary and sufficient condition.
changes.reason: Keep the limitation scoped to the prior landing point, not all evidentiary value of results.

changes.before: And there is no test. Anything that could be set out and followed from the outside proves something else: effort proves nothing, how much one draws on it proves nothing, what happens after the warrant is withdrawn proves nothing. What remains is the retrospect itself — the first person following the account backwards to see where the chain of standing stops. At one of his own rows, or at an external warrant. It is not a procedure. It is a tracing back.
changes.after: One further point must be made clear, lest this passage be read as an executable procedure: this branch has no test. Anything that could be set out and followed from the outside proves something else: neither the effort involved, nor how much one draws on it, nor the results after the warrant is withdrawn can establish this state. What remains is the retrospect itself — the first person following the account backwards to see where the chain of standing stops. At one of his own rows, or at an external warrant. It is not a procedure. It is a tracing back.
changes.reason: Restore the explicit warning about construing retrospective tracing as an external procedure. Independent review also restored the specific object of the three evidentiary denials: they cannot establish this state, rather than proving nothing at all.

changes.before: Third, no one else can issue this reading. That is not a prohibition but an impossibility: reading it requires following the bearer's own law. A man who says this was never really yours has not determined self-colonization; he cannot. What he has done is something else — handing down an attribution the bearer cannot check, which is exactly the relational structure external colonization requires. The two branches lock together here.
